subject: Physics (Class 12)

criteria.point: Correct definition or concept stated clearly
Relevant formula written with correct symbols
SI units correctly identified for all quantities
Conciseness and absence of contradictory statements

instructions: Award marks strictly per criterion; deduct for wrong units even if the method is correct.

subject: Mathematics (Class 12)

criteria.point: Each step shown clearly with working
Final answer correct with appropriate form
Units or domain stated where applicable

instructions: Follow step-marking strictly; a correct final answer with no working shown receives only the final-answer mark.

subject: English (Class 10)

criteria.point: Addresses the question directly with relevant key points
Accurate use of textual evidence or examples
Clarity and logical flow of ideas

instructions: Reward depth over length; penalise vague statements that restate the question without adding substance.

subject: General (Fallback)

criteria.point: Coverage of main points expected in the answer

instructions: Use this rubric only when no subject-specific rubric matches; focus on whether the answer is complete and well-reasoned.
